items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: And Tom Burton, we used to play a reggae

ctx.x: What pieces did you play then?

Well most of those they've come to places like there was something. They played plenty of blues you know like St. Louis Blues. Nella was one of our main hosts. The other bands couldn't play it. They didn't know how we got it you see. Of course that was the number we fixed. The piece of music was Nella, that was the name of it. Well we cut the name off you see. And Tom Burton, we used to play a reggae and one night we were always playing, had a good crowd of people playing color dance. They had a couple of drinks…
And we made it. And made it.
